meta.title: SMS Gateway — Android SMS Gateway, API & n8n
meta.description: Turn an Android phone into a professional SMS gateway. Dashboard, REST API, webhooks, and automations. Join the waitlist.

landing.heroLead: Send and receive SMS from the dashboard, REST API, or n8n webhooks — no carrier contracts. Ideal for automations, alerts, and integrations that need real SMS.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to scale SMS
landing.featuresSub: Built for technical teams and businesses that want full control without expensive carrier APIs.
landing.feature1Desc: Integrate with any system. Automatic queue and delivery status.
landing.feature2Desc: Received SMS in the dashboard and forwarded to n8n or your backend.
landing.feature3Desc: Multiple Android phones as gateways, with real-time online status.
landing.feature4Desc: Isolated users, API keys, and permissions per team.
landing.feature5Desc: Dashboard with SSE — no manual refresh for SMS and queue.
landing.feature6Desc: QR code in the dashboard. The phone connects in seconds.
landing.step1Desc: Dedicated app uses the phone SIM to send and receive SMS reliably.
landing.step2Desc: Secure connection to your account. SIM number detected automatically.
landing.step3Desc: API, web dashboard, or webhooks — SMS flows into your business.
landing.waitlistSub: We are preparing to open for more customers. Leave your email and help us prioritize features based on real demand.
landing.waitlistPerk1: Early access when we open spots
landing.waitlistUseCase: How do you plan to use it?
landing.waitlistNote: We do not share your email. No spam, only relevant updates.

recovery.desc: Administrator accounts only. Requires the secret defined in ADMIN_RECOVERY_SECRET on the server (EasyPanel / .env). Never share this code.

webhook.title: Webhook n8n
webhook.desc: Forward received SMS to your n8n flow (POST JSON).
webhook.manualHint: Manual: ↗ button in received SMS table

api.keyDesc: Authenticate requests with your API key (query api_key or header X-Api-Key). SMS is queued and sent by the paired Android device.
api.sendDesc: Parameters: phone (destination), msg (text). GET or POST method.
api.statusDesc: Check the status of an SMS sent via API. Use the id returned by send.
api.note1: At least one Android device must be online and active to send.
api.note2: Regenerating the API key invalidates existing integrations.
api.note3: Common errors: 401 invalid key · 400 missing parameters · 404 SMS not found.

users.inactiveHint: New users remain inactive until activated in the table.
users.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete account "{name}"? All associated devices and data will be removed.
users.regenKeyConfirm: Regenerate API key? Existing integrations will stop working.

system.title: Public server URL
system.desc: Domain used in QR codes, pairing links, and APK for all users. Use the public HTTPS URL (e.g. https://sms.company.com).
system.recoveryEnabled: Active — ADMIN_RECOVERY_SECRET is set on the server.
system.recoveryDisabled: Inactive — set ADMIN_RECOVERY_SECRET (min. 24 characters) in EasyPanel to enable emergency recovery.
system.recoveryHow: If locked out: on the login screen use “Administrator recovery” with the secret, or on the server run: npx tsx scripts/reset-admin-password.ts --email YOUR_EMAIL --password "NEW_PASSWORD"
system.recoveryNote: Only affects administrator accounts. The secret is never shown in the dashboard — store it in a password manager.
